node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const html = fs.readFileSync('superman-ride.html', 'utf8'); const scripts = [...html.matchAll(/<script>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/g)]; scripts.forEach(([, source]) => new Function(source)); const ids = [...html.matchAll(/\bid=\"([^\"]+)\"/g)].map(m => m[1]); if (new Set(ids).size !== ids.length) throw new Error('Duplicate IDs'); const refs = [...html.matchAll(/(?:href=\"#|url\(#)([\w-]+)/g)].map(m => m[1]); refs.forEach(id => { if (!ids.includes(id)) throw new Error('Missing SVG reference: ' + id); }); if (/(?:src|href)=\"https?:/.test(html)) throw new Error('External dependency'); console.log('PASS: JavaScript syntax, unique IDs, SVG references, no external dependencies'); console.log('File: superman-ride.html | ' + Buffer.byteLength(html) + ' bytes');"
